title: A tool returned needing repair is marked as needing repair through the outbox
when: With command handlers sharing one outbox over an in-memory database and tools on loan, once without the event handler subscribed, once with it and once with it failing, returns loans needing repair with a note, needing repair with a blank note, in good condition, and needing repair on a tool whose damage was already reported; after the failure, clears the fault, runs the relay again, then marks Tool returned undelivered and runs it once more.
then: Without the handler, the return changes only the loan, and Tool returned is saved to the outbox with it and relayed with its fields; a refused return saves nothing. With it, Damage reported follows Tool returned and the tool needs repair with the return note, or "Returned needing repair." when there is none; a good return invokes nothing; a tool that already needs repair keeps its first report and Tool returned is delivered. When the handler fails, the return stands, the failure is reported and Tool returned stays undelivered; the next relay run delivers it and the tool needs repair, and delivering it again changes nothing.
